title: Hidden Harmony
author: NewTimesRoman
selftext:
I've wanted to make a game for a long time. Being a writer by nature, I didn't really have the money or the ability to create the kinds of assets I wanted or the code I needed. 

Long story short, I leaned into the writing, character and video work and made a demo for a visual novel. I have used items like chatgpt and grok to create assets as well as original songs for the kpop inspired Visual Novel I made. 

It's not a commercial product yet, and I don't know if I'm taking it there. I would just like some more eyes on it if possible. 

The demo is available for free on itch.io. Please take 30 minutes of your time and tell me how I did and if I should expand it. [Hidden Harmony Demo on itch.io](https://romanbedivere.itch.io/hidden-harmony)
